tasks.label: Abrir sistema de procesos
args: $root=(Get-Location).Path; if (-not (Get-Command javac -EA SilentlyContinue)) { $hallado=Get-ChildItem -Path 'C:\Program Files\Java','C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium','C:\Program Files\Microsoft','C:\Program Files\Amazon Corretto' -Filter javac.exe -Recurse -EA SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($hallado) { $env:Path = $hallado.DirectoryName + ';' + $env:Path } }; $bin=Join-Path $root 'bin'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $bin | Out-Null; $srcs=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Filter *.java | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }); javac -encoding UTF-8 -d $bin @srcs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $item=Get-Item -LiteralPath $bin -Force; $item.Attributes=$item.Attributes -bor [IO.FileAttributes]::Hidden; Start-Process javaw -WorkingDirectory $root -ArgumentList '-cp',$bin,'Main'
